cache_policy: Raw cache verified by payload SHA256 and expected audited source SHA256; reuse requires unchanged source size and mtime. Full input recheck is explicit.
depth_origin: Depth = plate thickness - saved model y; zero is the original plate OD
interpretation: Suppression is optional. Coherence-weighted scores are not calibrated amplitudes. Known LOF is display-only.
ray_model: Homogeneous bulk rays inside steel; flat backwall and exposed OD/fill-top reflections only. Earliest valid flat upper branch. No sloped groove reflection or corner diffraction. Rayleigh guides only along one unobstructed flat face.
